description: Figure 10 is a grouped bar chart illustrating the effect of context masking on case tasks, categorized by language family. The horizontal axis lists the language families: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic family, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical axis, labeled “effect,” is scaled linearly from 0 to 30, with tick marks at intervals of 10, representing the magnitude of the effect in unspecified units. Each language family group contains six bars, each corresponding to a different multilingual BERT model variant as indicated by the legend: mBERT-L₂ (light blue), XLM-L₂ (dark blue), mBERT-R₂ (light green), XLM-R₂ (dark green), mBERT-B₂ (light red), and XLM-B₂ (dark red). The bars are arranged in the order of the legend, with each bar's height representing the mean effect for that model on the respective language family’s case tasks. Error bars extend vertically from each bar, indicating the standard deviation of the effect. The chart shows that for most language families, the effect sizes vary across models, with some models (e.g., XLM-R₂ in IE-Indic and XLM-B₂ in Semitic) showing notably higher effects than others. The bars are not sorted by height; they are presented in the order of the language families along the x-axis. No bars are visually emphasized or annotated beyond the error bars.
